label: Drag to pose: the raider's idle. Drag a white handle (hand, foot), the blue hips or the green head; the small ring beside a hand or foot twists it. Try dragging a foot up.
The spearman holding the staff: the gold fist moves the staff (its ring turns it), the hollow gold fist swings it round the other hand; both fists stay on the shaft
The turning slash's strike frame (ratSlash frame 43, chest toward camera)
A shared pose: the raider's far foot dragged up 20 px (what Share sends; the link holds the pose)
In the normal viewer: View tab -> Pose -> 'Pose this frame' opens the pose page on whatever frame is showing
